resources.string: This phone can’t confirm this group’s admin. The admin’s changes may not be applied here, and someone the admin removed may still read what you write.
Check
This phone can’t confirm this group’s admin

This phone can’t tell which of your chats belongs to the admin of this group. Until that is settled, the admin’s changes are ignored here: removing a member, a new group key and the member list. Someone the admin already removed can still read what you write in this group.

The security key this group trusts for its admin is no longer the key of any of your chats: the admin’s key changed, or your secure chat with them was reset. Until you confirm the admin again, their changes may be ignored here, and someone they removed may still read what you write in this group.
The address stored as this group’s admin is your chat with %1$s (%2$s).
ZChat’s records on this phone show that the invitation to this group came from your chat with %1$s (%2$s).

Compare your safety number with %1$s first: open the chat, open the menu, tap “Verify safety number”, compare the number with them in person or on a call you trust, and mark it as verified. If the numbers don’t match, don’t mark it and don’t confirm. Then come back here.
%1$s’s security key changed and that is not settled yet. Settle the security key warning in your chat with %1$s first.
Your chat with %1$s is not a finished secure chat yet. Open it and finish setting up the secure chat first; then compare your safety number with them.
This phone has no record of which of your chats belongs to this group’s admin, so it can’t offer a check. Ask the admin to create a new group and invite everyone again.

There is a secure chat at the address stored as this group’s admin, but this phone has not confirmed that it belongs to the admin. Until you confirm it, the admin’s changes may be ignored here, and someone the admin removed may still read what you write in this group.

ZChat can’t confirm this group’s admin on this phone. Until ZChat can, the admin’s changes may not be applied here. The admin has already changed the group key, so this phone may not be able to read new messages in this group, and the member list here may be out of date.
Open chat
Confirm the admin
Confirm this group’s admin?
%1$s (%2$s) will be able to remove members and change the key of “%3$s” on this phone. Confirm only if %1$s is the person who created this group and you compared this safety number with them: %4$s
Changes this person already made to this group are applied right after you confirm, as far as this phone has them. If they removed you from the group, you leave it then.
You can’t change this later in ZChat 2.13. If it turns out to be wrong, the admin has to create a new group.
Confirm
Admin confirmed

From now on this phone applies the changes %1$s makes to this group. ZChat now applies the earlier changes this phone has: those sent on the chain, and those that reached it over the relays since this update. Changes that reached this phone over the relays before that are not applied: if the admin removed someone back then, that person may still be in this phone’s member list and may read what you write, until the admin’s member list arrives or the admin changes the group key.
Nothing was confirmed: something changed while this was open. Check again.
ZChat couldn’t save this, so nothing was confirmed. Free up some space or restart your phone, then try again.
ZChat saved the key you compared, but this person’s key changed while it was being saved, and ZChat couldn’t undo that. Check this group’s admin again.
The admin’s member list has not reached this phone yet. Someone the admin removed earlier may still read what you write here. Ask the admin to open this group in ZChat 2.13 or newer.
This phone can’t read the newest messages here, and the admin’s ZChat is older than 2.13, so it can’t send the key again on request. Ask the admin to update ZChat or to change the group key again.
